business.name: Business English programme
includes: A plan built on your job, your meetings and your deadlines
Your real emails, slides and reports corrected in the lesson
A review at lesson 5 and lesson 10

interview.name: Interview intensive
includes: Answers prepared for the questions your interviewer is likely to ask
Written feedback on your answers and delivery

ielts.name: IELTS sprint
includes: 4 writing tasks marked against the band descriptors
1 full speaking mock with written feedback
Timing technique for reading and listening
A study plan for each week

ecl.name: ECL C1 course
includes: All four papers covered: reading, writing, listening, speaking
Mock tests marked to the official criteria
A vocabulary bank for each topic group
A plan for each of the five weeks

ziad.name: Ziad
ziad.text: Thirty-six lessons in since December, and I've never once been tempted to stop. Lawrence listens properly; he picks up on what you're actually struggling with and shapes the lesson around it, rather than working through a script. Patient, always well prepared, and lovely company into the bargain.

pavel.name: Pavel
pavel.text: Lawrence is not only an excellent English teacher, but he also has a great background and knowledge in business, which certainly helps in learning business English and developing not only language skills but also business knowledge. The lessons are always engaging and informative.

janos.name: János
janos.text: Always punctual, patient, and attentive, correcting me only when truly necessary. He speaks genuine British English and helped me turn passive vocabulary into active, fluent speech within weeks.

michael.name: Michael
michael.text: Lawrence is a kind, professional, and easy-to-deal-with tutor. I feel safe and calm while talking and learning with him, as he supports my IELTS exam preparation.

guido.name: Guido
guido.text: He is knowledgeable, patient and professional. The lessons are always interesting, engaging and tailored to my needs. He explains things clearly and makes me feel comfortable and confident.

katarzyna.name: Katarzyna
katarzyna.text: He can explain the meaning of words and context of their use very well. With Lawrence I can learn what I really need, not just formulas from the text books.
